annealed_pressure_beta_half.cite: SK pressure lim (1/N) E ln Z_N at beta = 1/2, h = 0 (J_ij unit Gaussian over sqrt N, the package's J ~ N(0, 1/N)): the annealed value log 2 + beta^2/4 for 0 <= beta <= 1. Guerra, 'Fluctuations and thermodynamic variables in mean field spin glass models' (1992), arXiv:1212.2905, PDF read: Theorem 3, Eq. (3.6) 'lim alpha_N(beta) = log 2 + beta^2/4 ... uniformly for 0 <= beta <= 1' (his Hamiltonian (2.3) normalises by sqrt(N - 1), equivalent as N -> oo, as he states after (2.3)); the annealed upper bound (2.16)-(2.18) for every beta. Aizenman, Lebowitz & Ruelle, Comm. Math. Phys. 112, 3 (1987) (beta < 1; cited there as [6], not fetched: the Project Euclid PDF link returned HTML). Value: log 2 + 1/16 by mpmath at 40 digits, rounded to 30 places; tol 1e-29
annealed_pressure_beta_half.independent_route: replicant's certified minimum over q of Guerra's RS bound (bounds/guerra.py guerra_rs_best_bound(1/2, 0)): G'(q) = d/dq (q - E tanh^2(beta sqrt(q) z)) > 0 is certified on a cover of [0, 1] by ball arithmetic and G(0) = 0, so q = 0 is the unique minimiser; the value P_RS(0) is a ball; tests compare it with ln 2 + beta^2/4 built separately in arb. Normalisation: Guerra's ordered-pair sum over sqrt(N - 1) with log 2 + beta^2/4 and beta_c = 1 is the package's unordered-pair J_ij ~ N(0, 1/N) (his annealed computation (2.17))
